svg.title: One PlanMotions call, call by call
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram, animated: Scheduler::PlanMotions builds the inputs and calls Chugg::SolveSequential, which sets up one SippAgv per AGV, then for every event in topological order plans it with SIPP or a fixed duration and carves the result into the other AGVs' tables, and finally checks collisions and returns the ContinuousState.
svg.metadata: ["PlanMotions builds CHUGG's inputs: every entity standing still until start_time, the trapezoid time of every graph edge, and the all-pairs cost table SIPP uses as its A* heuristic (Floyd-Warshall, recomputed on every call). The Chugg constructor takes a topological order of the event DAG and replays it once.", "SolveSequential starts. SolveInitialization finds the movable AGVs and planning_start_, the trays, bays and VECS that have events, and builds constraints_: per footprint, the vertices and edges blocked by anything that never moves in this plan.", "MakeRootNode: one SippAgv per movable AGV. Every initial motion that ends after planning_start_, and every parked tray or closed bay without events, is carved into the other AGVs' safe-interval tables. Then each AgvMove and TrayMove becomes a SIPP goal of its AGV, in topological order.", "The loop visits every event in topological order. For an AgvMove or TrayMove: the AGV is free when its last motion ends; the event may start when the last motion of each dependency has ended. If that is later, a wait motion (with this event's id) fills the gap and is carved into the other AGVs.", "SetEventSafeIntervals copies the AGV's safe-interval table, then adds the sequential assumption: every motion of every other entity, and a resting motion at its last pose until Timepoint::max, is carved in. Under this assumption nothing planned later can move out of the way.", "SIPP plans this one event. PlanEvents builds a SippEnvironment over the AGV's table and runs the generic A*, which calls back GetHeuristic, OnExpansion and GetNeighbors until a state completes the goal (or 5,000,000 expansions). The path of SippStates becomes Motions in a Trajectory.", "Commit. The AGV's table is restored from the copy, each new motion is appended to the node's trajectory for this AGV and carved into every other AGV's table for good. A lift also ends (pick-up) or starts (drop) the tray's parked motion.", "Bay and VECS events need no search: one motion of fixed duration (a closing bay first waits until no planned motion collides with the door area), carved into every AGV's table. Every event, of any type, is then applied to the working state before the loop moves on.", "After the loop: a pairwise collision check over all new motions (any collision means std::nullopt), then the new motions are appended to a copy of the initial ContinuousState and returned. The scheduler turns it into the action DAG (Action graph tab)."]
